description: Detach a skill from an agent. The skill stays in the organization for other agents, including an organization copy installed from the catalog. Give a built-in's name to detach Valet's default of it. The agent is rebuilt so it stops carrying the skill. Detaching a skill that is not attached changes nothing. Returns the agent, the skill, and whether it was attached at all. Requires connecting a Valet account.

name.description: The agent's name, as list_services shows it: the agent to detach the skill from.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

skill.description: The skill's name, or a ref such as catalog:<name> or org:<name>.

name: detach_skill

kind.description: Kind of the service the skill attaches to. Always agent: skills attach to agents only.

not_attached.description: True when the skill was not attached and nothing changed. Absent when it was detached.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

skill.description: The skill as you passed it.

title: Detach a skill from an agent
